text: Hello. I am your reading teacher. I will help you.
Tap the shining sound to go on.
Tap the next lesson to go on.
Tap the arrow to go on.
Follow the faint letter. Go slowly.
This is an alien word. Sound it out.
This is a made-up word. Sound it out.
This word is not tricky. Sound it out.
Read it out loud. Then tap to hear it.
That part sounds normal. Find the different part.
Tap the letter. I will wait.
Take your time. Tap the one you think.
Say it out loud. Then tap the button.
Put your finger on the letter. Trace it.
Tap the arrow when you are ready.
Need help? Tap the speaker to hear me again.
I will wait here. Tap when you are ready.
Not open yet. Finish the check first.
When we read, we use the sound, not the name.
The letter q is called cue. With u, it says
Make two fists with your thumbs up. Hold them side by side. The left fist is b. The right fist is d. Together they make bed.
b: the bat comes first, then the ball. The belly of b points right.
d: the drum comes first, then the stick. The belly of d points left.
p hangs down. Its loop is at the top, on the right.
q hangs down too. It always needs its u.
This is the check for the whole level. Do your best.
You passed! The next level is open.
Not yet. Let's practise the parts that were hard, then try again.
Here is a new spelling for a sound. Tap it to hear it.
This is an ending. Read the base word, then add the ending.
Here it is in a word.
These letters keep both sounds. Say them quickly together.
Here is a rule that helps you read.
A long word. Let's break it apart, step by step.
Each vowel sound makes one chunk.
Tap the parts at the start or end that you know.
Nothing to take off here. Go on.
Tap each chunk to say it, then put them together.
Is it a real word? If not, try the vowel the other way.
Show how you read a word you have never seen.
Not a vowel sound. Try another.
Before you read, think about this.
Read each word out loud. Then tap it.
Build the word. Tap the parts in order.
Read one part at a time. Tap a sentence to hear it.
Read it out loud. Tap start when you are ready.
Think first. Then tap to see a good answer.
How did you do? Tap one.
Write your answer. Then compare it.
Take each role. Say your answer out loud.
